title: kbingest's pattern-row guard accepts overlapping quantifiers split by a fixed atom or over classes outside its probe alphabet, and the file timeout cannot stop one slow line
goal: The pattern-row guard refuses a rules row whose variable-width atoms overlap across a fixed atom and over any Unicode class (not only chr(0) to chr(0x2ff)); tools.md states that the 10-second file bound is read between lines, so one slow line is not cut

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import kbingest as k;rows=[r"\w+.\w+.\w+(?P<name>y)",chr(91)+chr(0x430)+"-"+chr(0x44f)+chr(93)+"+"+chr(91)+chr(0x430)+"-"+chr(0x44f)+chr(93)+"+(?P<name>y)"];bad=[p for p in rows if k.rule_row({"language":"lua","role":"def","kind":"function","pattern":p},1,"sensitive")[0] is not None];sys.exit("guard accepts %r"%bad if bad else 0)
import sys;t=open("kb/_self/tools.md",encoding="utf-8").read();i=t.index("or after 10 seconds");sys.exit(0 if "between lines" in t[i:i+300] else 1)

clauses.clause: The pattern-row guard refuses a rules row whose variable-width atoms overlap across a fixed atom and over any Unicode class (not only chr(0) to chr(0x2ff))
tools.md states that the 10-second file bound is read between lines, so one slow line is not cut

gates.question: How does the pattern-row guard compare atoms over all of Unicode, and when does a fixed atom between two variable atoms keep them ambiguous?
options: Probe every character below U+0300, one per 64 code points above and each character the regex writes; a fixed atom keeps a pending atom as the characters both match
Probe every code point of Unicode for every atom
gates.recommendation: Probe every character below U+0300, one per 64 code points above and each character the regex writes; a fixed atom keeps a pending atom as the characters both match
gates.answer: Probe every character below U+0300, one per 64 code points above and each character the regex writes; a fixed atom keeps a pending atom as the characters both match

notes: Review gap G4 of SP-n7zxspch. kbingest.py:1759 PATTERN_PROBE spans chr(0) to chr(0x2ff), so a class outside it compares as empty: [a-ya Cyrillic]+[same]+ passes the guard and takes about 0.4 s on 990 letters. kbingest.py:1764 adjacent_overlap stops at a fixed atom: \w+.\w+.\w+ is accepted, is cubic, and takes 7 s on a 400-letter line. kbingest.py:2009 reads the clock once per line (gate g1 of BG-76mclha4), so the file timeout does not bound a slow line, while tools.md says a file stops after 10 seconds. Never run these regexes on 1000 characters in a check. Choice settled in the plan: the timeout part is a doc fix, not new code (the clock stays read once per line), so tools.md says 'read between lines'. Clause 1 is the repro; run its regexes only on short lines in a check. Planned in SP-uz3rhdlq: repro/checks fail on the base, touches and order set.
